messages:
mira-partnerships: Quick kickoff for Galloway (eu-west-8) with Meridian Cloud + their SI. They want marketplace SKU + private tenant HSM and a staged quota rollout. Can we align on quotas, entitlements, and timeline?
dan-cloud: Need numbers and SKU name. Meridian mentioned starting small: 6 reserved GPUs, burst to 14 for validation runs. Rafael, confirm?
rafael-si: Confirmed: 6 NVIDIA A30 equiv reserved, burst 14. We'll run two stress events during onboarding week. Need tenant-isolation on the marketplace listing and key-wrapping support.
zara-ops: For quota ticket I'll need exact paste-ready block. Use this format: `project, region, sku, requested` — paste below and I will file.
mira-partnerships: Copying suggested block here:
```
project: redwood-prod
region: eu-west-8
sku: redwood-edge-a30
requested: 14
notes: reserved 6, burst to 14 for onboarding stress tests, partner: Meridian
```
noor-legal: Legal note: Meridian SI will have access to aggregated logs for debugging. Need confirmation whether logs include unredacted customer prompts. If yes, we require a DPA + SI access appendix. Can we get that info?
rafael-si: For pilot we only need request IDs and anonymized traces, no raw prompts. We can sign DPA wording that restricts prompt retention.
pete-sre: Rollout plan proposal: dev (1 GPU node) -> internal canary (2 GPUs) -> partner canary (4 GPUs) -> full pilot reserved (6 GPUs). Smoke tests at each step; perf run at 6 -> burst to 14. Also require maintenance window for kernel prep.
marketplace-bot: [marketplace-bot] draft SKU created: https://marketplace.internal/drafts/redwood-edge-meridian-euw8. Entitlements: tenant-isolation, private-kms, si-agent-access. Review requested: mira-partnerships, dan-cloud.
dan-cloud: KMS flow: we support envelope encryption with partner KMS. Need service account and key ARN for pilot. Will support Thales HSM integration for prod but need endpoint+auth model. Rafael to provide.
rafael-si: We'll provide AWS KMS ARNs for pilot and HSM contact for prod next 24h. Rotation: monthly for pilot.
zara-ops: Filing quota ticket now with high priority. ETA from cloud partner ~72h. I'll include maintenance window proposal: June 2 02:00-05:00 UTC for node prep.
mira-partnerships: Timeline ask from Meridian: pilot demo week of June 10. Can we aim for partner canary by June 3 and reserved capacity by June 7?
pete-sre: Tight but feasible if KMS ARNs + quota approval arrive this week. We'll schedule perf harness June 4-5.
noor-legal: I'll start a two-party DPA draft and include SI access appendix with prompt pseudonymization clause. Will share link in #legal by EOD.
mira-partnerships: Next steps summary: 1) rafael send KMS ARNs + HSM contact (today) 2) zara file quota ticket (done) 3) marketplace review SKU entitlements (marketplace-bot) 4) pete schedule canary + perf (pending quotas) 5) noor draft DPA. Ping me if blockers. :white_check_mark:
dan-cloud: ack. Rafael, please DM the ARNs to me and cc infra@redwood.ai.
rafael-si: Sending ARNs now. Thanks everyone.
mira-partnerships: Closing thread, post status updates here as they happen.
